actionable_steps.step: Hold a fixed daily routine — wake at the same hour, order your morning duties, and do not let the schedule drift day to day.

actionable_steps.citation: Discipline is the Life Principle of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-19
actionable_steps.step: Before you speak or write, enquire whether it is proper — observe appropriate limits in speech.

actionable_steps.citation: Discipline is the Life Principle of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-19
actionable_steps.step: Discipline the senses: see no evil, hear no evil, talk no evil, think no evil, do no evil.

actionable_steps.citation: Akhanda Bhajan - Continuous Namasmarana Is The Goal — SSS Vol 40 (2007), 2007-11-13
actionable_steps.step: Let discipline become your breath — the same in every place and every situation, not only at home.

actionable_steps.citation: Discipline is the Life Principle of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-19
actionable_steps.step: Eat in discipline — fill three parts of the stomach and leave the fourth part empty.

definition.citation: Discipline is the Life Principle of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-19
definition.quote: Discipline is like the primordial life principle for every living being. For all human beings, it is like their backbone. Discipline means to follow certain rules and regulations implicitly.

discourses.citation: Discipline is the Life Principle of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-19
discourses.quote: Without discipline, there can be no well-being (Na sreyo niyamam vina). Humanness cannot survive in the absence of rules and regulations. The entire human race will be wiped out if there is no discipline.

Discipline should be strictly followed in daily life. From the moment you wake up, you have to carry out your morning ablutions, meditate on God and then do your prescribed duties in an orderly manner without deviating from the regular routine.
Na Sreyo Niyamam Vina, No success without discipline. If you don't follow discipline, it results in danger.

discourses.citation: Akhanda Bhajan - Continuous Namasmarana Is The Goal — SSS Vol 40 (2007), 2007-11-13
discourses.quote: Our discipline should be connected with our whole life and not with one place and one time. To whatever place you may go and whatever the situation may be, you must maintain discipline... our discipline should become our breath.

make_it_real: Discipline is your backbone — stand straight in it today, from morning to night.
title: Discipline

vahinis.quote: Spiritual learning (vidya) involves humility, tolerance, and discipline. It destroys arrogance, envy, and all related vices. Such knowledge is the real Atmic knowledge.

In fact, dhyana (meditation) means "discipline". Discipline, regularity, steadiness —these are the essentials of meditation. A spiritual aspirant who keeps these things in view can achieve quick results.
